key_reasoning.reason: New top-level package idp_sync_job with separate modules (coordinator, entrypoint, keycloak_source, platform_client, reconcile, settings, state, tokens) replacing the old in-repo enterprise sync; also Dockerfile.sync and cronjob chart.
Token handling and authenticated calls to Keycloak and the platform IDP sync API (auth-sensitive); no exact precedent for the standalone job; import-purity constraint between packages.
36 files changed (3213 insertions, 2462 deletions) including removal of old sync and its tests, new job package and new tests.
